messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: P0 - high error rate on inference-canary in eu-west-1 (alert: pod_crashloop_count > 0) :rotating_light:
maya: seeing this alert, pulling logs now. pinging oncall.
tom: I'm oncall - looking. what's the canary id?
maya: canary rollout 2026-03-15-06:12 GMT. brief summary: recent deploy changed podAntiAffinity and bumped cpu requests. HPA target still aggressive.
tom: k. can you paste pod list + statuses?
maya: ```
kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide | grep canary
inference-canary-7d8f6   CrashLoopBackOff   1/1   10m   10.0.2.45   node-eu-1
inference-canary-7d8f6   CrashLoopBackOff   0/1   9m    10.0.2.45   node-eu-1
inference-canary-b2f3c   Running            1/1   12m   10.0.3.22   node-eu-2
```
maya: looks like one pod stuck on node-eu-1 repeating restarts, other on eu-2 is fine.
tom: getting logs from the crashing pod...
tom: ```
kubectl -n inference logs inference-canary-7d8f6
E0320 06:14:12.123456 1 server.cpp:201] out of memory allocating KV cache  (requested 512MB)
Warning: OOMKilled
```
ana: hmm OOM on only that node. are resource limits honored? maybe affinity forced two heavy pods on same host.
meredith: I pulled the rollout manifest diff: antiAffinity term was tightened to requiredDuringScheduling (previously preferredDuringScheduling). that can cause packing. also cpu request increased from 2 -> 4.
tom: that combination could pin both replicas to same node if labels match, then host runs out. also HPA set minReplicas=2 so it kept creating.
maya: customer impact: small % of requests failing (~3% errors) for some EU customers; 95th latency spikes to 2.8s vs usual 200ms. volume low but error rate notable. (monitoring: https://console.redwood/inference/canary/metrics)
ops-bot: NOTE: 2 incidents open: #INC-2026-042 - inference-canary degradation; auto-note created for SRE.
tom: decision: abort rollout and flip canary feature flag off. who can flip the ff?
meredith: I can toggle the feature flag via ff-admin. will mark as kill-switch action and notify product.
meredith: ```
ff-admin toggle inference_canary_enabled --env=eu-west-1 --value=false --actor=meredith
# response: "flag inference_canary_enabled disabled in eu-west-1"```
meredith: flag toggled. routing should go to stable now.
maya: confirming traffic shift in LB - new requests hit stable. error rate falling.
nana: recommend scaling HPA down to minReplicas=1 temporarily and patching antiAffinity back to preferred.
tom: agree. I'll apply emergency patch to manifest and scale HPA.
tom: ```
kubectl -n inference patch hpa inference-hpa -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":1}}'
kubectl -n inference patch deployment inference-canary -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"affinity":{"podAntiAffinity":{"requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution":null,"preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution":[{"weight":100,"podAffinityTerm":{"labelSelector":{"matchLabels":{"app":"inference"}},"topologyKey":"kubernetes.io/hostname"}}]}}}}}'
```
maya: pretty quick effect: crashed pod restarted and now passing readiness.
operational: minutes since flag toggle -> 3, error rate down to baseline. latency normalizing.
meredith: notifying product and customers: "We detected an issue with a new canary that caused elevated errors for a subset of EU traffic. We rolled back the canary flag and applied an emergency manifest fix. No further action required unless you see more errors."
tom: creating follow-up ticket for rollback + root cause: #SRE-4572. assign to ana for RCA.
ana: ack, will take RCA, will include commit id and manifest diff + suggestions to add integration test for antiAffinity changes and gate CPU request increases.
meredith: handoff note for next rotation: "Incident resolved, monitoring green. killed canary via flag, applied affinity patch, scaled HPA to 1. root cause suspected: required antiAffinity + increased CPU requests led to packing and OOM on single node. follow-up: revert default manifest in staging and add integration test."
sre-rotations: next-oncall @darren. please review #SRE-4572 tomorrow.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status=resolved, severity=major -> resolved; duration=9m; responders=[maya,tom,meredith,ana]; notes="kill-switch used, emergency manifest patch, HPA scaled down" :white_check_mark:
meredith: adding postmortem label and will schedule blameless RCA async.
tom: closing channel - continuing postmortem in #postmortems. thanks team :heart:
